MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 60
   C. 19
   D. 38

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 15

3. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

6. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 10
   C. 100
   D. 11

7. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

9. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19

11. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Final Answer: 38 cm
